description: Explicit zero-plausible-gap proof for the SystemVerilog preprocessor formal-closure surface. RE-BASELINED 2026-10-19 (PGEN-SV-CORPUS-GRAD-0472, leaf SV-CORPUS-GRAD.13c.2v.21), version 3 -> 4: the unreachable surface is now EXPLAINED BY THE GRAMMAR, CLASS BY CLASS, instead of asserted empty. Release 1.0.9 (2026-10-18, SV-CORPUS-GRAD.13c.2v.8 - .16 / .20) gave the grammar nine GUARD rules read only by a negative lookahead (gap-report reason reachable_only_inside_lookahead), their 29 interior alternatives (inside_lookahead), and nine EDITION-GATED alternatives whose sole referenced rule the grammar gates to another edition by @profiles (references_rule_missing_from_active_grammar; the default profile sv_2017 does not load those rules). The syntax-closure contract was re-pinned for all three in the release slice; THIS contract was not (its v3 empty-set assertion broke on the first stranded rule, exactly as the baseline-identity register's deferred row predicted), the proof umbrella printed `passed` with zero_plausible_grammar_level_gap_proof_surface=false, and the family-status gate first said so in push-mirror run 8 (tracker 'Provisional (corpus pending)' vs computed 'Mostly Done'). v4 keeps the literal-zero doctrine for genuinely DEAD rules and branches (allowed_unreachable_rules and allowed_unreachable_branches stay EMPTY, reason unreachable_from_entry) and adds three classes the gate verifies against the oracles, never against this file alone: the guard set is pinned two-sided AND must equal the syntax-closure contract's expected_lookahead_only_rules (lockstep, one adjudication); every interior alternative must belong to a pinned guard and their count must equal expected_inside_lookahead_branches AND the syntax-closure contract's pin; every edition-gated alternative is pinned by id with its gated rule and that rule's @profiles, and the gate checks the gap report names that rule as the branch's reference and the grammar's raw AST (the syntax-closure gate's own product) carries exactly those @profiles on it, excluding @default_profile. A tenth guard, a thirtieth interior alternative, a tenth edition form, a dead rule, or any new reason is refused by name. HONEST LIMIT: the gap report runs the default profile only (no per-profile gap report exists), so an edition-gated alternative is proven unreachable-by-gating here, not reachable under its own edition; that reachability is measured by the release ceremony's per-profile census and certificate (the three-profile union UNKNOWN=0 fully_certified=true, .13c.2v.16). --- Earlier provenance, version 3 (kept verbatim): RE-BASELINED 2026-06-09 (PGEN-GRAMMAR-WELLFORMED-0052, leaf GRAMMAR-WELLFORMED.H.5.2): allowed_unreachable_rules tightened [trivia] -> [] and allowed_unreachable_branches tightened [branch::trivia::root/q#0..2] -> [], version 2 -> 3. The dead `trivia` rule (`(space_or_tab | line_comment | block_comment)*`) was the SOLE tolerated helper-pocket: it was referenced by NO rule (every rule uses the line-comment-free `inline_trivia` sibling) and was therefore OBJECTIVELY unreachable from the entry `systemverilog_preprocessor_file` — proven two independent ways: (A) static reference-graph closure (decidable Hopcroft-Ullman reduced-grammar reachability; PEG references are static literal names; nothing references `trivia`, no @include, entry != trivia), and (B) the independent `--gap-report-json` (`generate_gap_report`) oracle, which reported `trivia reachable=false reason=unreachable_from_entry` as the COMPLETE statically-unreachable-from-entry set while classifying the sibling never-witnessed rules `directive_tail`/`line_comment` as `reachable=true reason=never_hit`. Per the GRAMMAR-WELLFORMED literal-0 doctrine (a dead rule is an EBNF well-formedness defect to remove at source, not a residual to tolerate), `trivia` was removed from `grammars/systemverilog_preprocessor.ebnf`, so the observed unreachable surface is now EMPTY. Tightening the whitelist from [trivia] to [] makes the no-regression invariant STRICTLY STRONGER (any future regression that re-introduces an unreachable rule/branch is now caught). NOT masking: the genuine static-unreachable surface shrank to zero; the contract is updated to the new, better, literal-zero reality. The `directive_tail`/`line_comment` never_hit residuals are reachable (generator-reach) and are driven separately under GRAMMAR-WELLFORMED.H.5.3; they are NOT unreachable debt. Re-baselined per [[feedback_grammar_edit_proof_gate_lockstep]] (a grammar change owns ALL its downstream proof contracts in-slice).
done_rule: Done requires a machine-checkable proof that every syntax-unreachable rule and branch of the default-profile grammar graph is EXPLAINED by the grammar itself — dead: none (zero unreachable_from_entry rules and branches); guard: a rule read only by a negative lookahead, pinned two-sided here and in the syntax-closure contract; interior: an alternative inside a pinned guard, counted two-sided; edition-gated: an alternative whose sole referenced rule the grammar's own @profiles withhold from @default_profile, pinned by id with that rule and those profiles — while the retained aggregate and reachability sidecars still show zero reachable parser/gap debt.

expected_edition_gated_branches.form: the 1800-2023 multi-line block comment inside macro text
the 1364-2005 directive-word set inside macro text
the 1800-2023 `define with an escaped macro name and formals
the 1800-2023 triple-quoted string as a text lexeme
the 1800-2023 triple-quoted string as a text run's first lexeme

_classes_note: The gap report (rust/src/ast_pipeline/stimuli_generator.rs, generate_gap_report) assigns every unreachable rule and branch ONE reason, and the gate partitions the surface by that reason: unreachable_from_entry (dead — must equal allowed_unreachable_rules / allowed_unreachable_branches, both EMPTY), reachable_only_inside_lookahead (guard rules — must equal expected_lookahead_only_rules AND the syntax-closure contract's expected_lookahead_only_rules), inside_lookahead (interior alternatives — every one inside a pinned guard, their count expected_inside_lookahead_branches AND the syntax-closure contract's expected_inside_lookahead_branches), references_rule_missing_from_active_grammar (edition-gated — must equal expected_edition_gated_branches by id, each verified against the gap entry's rule_references and the grammar's @profiles / @default_profile as the syntax-closure gate's raw AST carries them). Any other reason is unclassified and refuses the proof. The guard and interior pins are deliberately spelled in BOTH contracts: a release that re-pins one and not the other is refused here by name (the 2026-10-18 shape), instead of a month later.
_edition_gated_note: RE-PINNED 2026-10-19 on the 1.0.9 grammar (release 2026-10-18, .13c.2v.9 per-edition profiles; .13c.2v.16 text_run_head): the nine are the branches the syntax-closure contract's _max_unreachable_branches_note already names, each one edition's own form withheld from the default profile sv_2017 by the @profiles line on its sole referenced rule. Not a gap: under sv_2023 / sv_2023_tolerant / verilog_2005 those rules load and the forms parse (the ceremony's per-profile census and the three-profile certificate union, UNKNOWN=0). A tenth is adjudicated by name; a gated rule that gains an sv_2017 reading, or loses its @profiles line, moves the branch out of this class and is refused until re-pinned.
helper_only_whitelist_detail: SystemVerilog preprocessor zero-plausible-gap proof requires the syntax-unreachable surface to be EXPLAINED BY THE GRAMMAR, class by class — no dead rule or branch (the sole prior helper-pocket rule `trivia` and its three branches were removed at source as unreachable-from-entry dead code, GRAMMAR-WELLFORMED.H.5.2, and allowed_unreachable_rules / allowed_unreachable_branches stay EMPTY), the nine guard rules read only by a negative lookahead pinned two-sided in lockstep with the syntax-closure contract, their 29 interior alternatives counted two-sided, and the nine edition-gated alternatives pinned by id and verified against the grammar's own @profiles — while the aggregate and reachability sidecars remain green.
